Choosing an AI journal app in 2026

faq.q: Is there a free AI journal app?
faq.a: Yes, with limits. As of October 2026, Mindsera's free Curious plan includes AI prompting, ChatGPT has a free tier with limited memory, and Apple Journal is free with on-device suggestions. Day One's AI features need its Gold plan, and Rosebud retired its free plan on September 30, 2026.

faq.q: What is the best Rosebud alternative?
faq.a: It depends on what you liked about Rosebud. For a conversation that turns into a journal entry, look at Day One's Daily Chat or Auserene; for analysis and frameworks, Mindsera; for a free option with no AI chat, Apple Journal.

faq.q: Did Rosebud get rid of its free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Rosebud's help center says the free plan was retired effective September 30, 2026, because its new memory system costs more to run. Existing entries stay and can be exported.

Some are more private than others. An app whose AI runs on a server has to read your words to reply, so end-to-end encryption can't cover that moment. Check whether your writing trains models, which AI providers see it and under what terms, and how deletion works.

faq.q: Can an AI journal replace therapy?
faq.a: No. An AI journal can help you notice patterns and put a day into words, but it doesn't diagnose or treat anything. If you're struggling, talk to a doctor or a mental health professional.
